Hourly workers now get paid the evening their shift ends, not a week later. Inés Navarro Head of Payroll Operations, Halbrisk Industry Payroll and HR Headquarters Valencia Team size 120 Products ACH, Instant payments, Account verification Customer since 2023 All customers Challenge Halbrisk relied on a batch payroll provider that paid workers on a fixed weekly cycle. Off-cycle payments took days to approve, and failed transfers were only spotted after workers complained. Solution Halbrisk moved its payouts to Nodo's ACH API, with account verification before the first payment and instant transfers for workers who choose to be paid daily.
